page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: one column of running text (dictionary entries in Greek and Latin), with a running head "ΠΟ" at top centre and page number 372 at top left. Right page: a narrow column of marginal notes along the right edge, which belongs to the right printed page (page number 10 at top right). The margin notes of the left page: none. Right page: notes in the right margin only.

main_text.p: comparat. πονηρότερ(ος) α ον, nequior us, pejor us, Luc.11.26.
Πορεία ας ή via, iter, à πορεύω trajicio, quod est à πορδς ὁ portitor. & hoc à πόρ(ος) ὁ transitus. prät. med. πέπορςμαι. Th. πεύςω.
Πορεύομαι proficiscor. imperf. ἐπορευόμην ἐς. F. πορεύσομαι. prät. paff. πεπόρευμαι versatus fum, 1.Pet.4.3. a.1.paff. ἐπορεύθην ἡς ἡ abivi. a.1.paff. imperat. πορεύθητι.

Πορθέω ῶ vasto(à πέρθω diruo, depopulor. F. πέρ- σω. fut.2. πραθῶ & per metathefin πραθῶ. aor.2. ἔπραθον pro ἔπερθον. prät.med. πέπορθα, unde est πορθέω) imperf. ἐπόρθεον ων. Fut. ήσω. P. πεπόρθηκα. aor.1.act. ἐπόρθησας. part.a.1.act. πορθήσας αὐτῶ ὁ.
Ποεσμὸς ὁ quaestus, à ποείζω prabeo. F. ἰσω. P. πεποίηκα. prät.paff. πεποίεσμαι.

Πόρνη ης ἡ meretrix, à verbo πεενάω seu πέρνημι vendo. in prät.med. πέπορνα. πρνάω per epenthesin litera ν est à περάω transeo. item in ulteriora loca transfero, ut vendam, prout mercatores merces suas solent exportare & importare.
Πορνεύω fcortor. F. εύσω. aor.1. ἐπορνεύσα. P. πεπορνεύκα.
Πόρρω procul adv. Luc.14.32. comparat. πορρω-τέρω longius.

page.notes: Right margin notes are fragmentary and heavily damaged; they are not transcribed. Greek accents and some letters are doubtful throughout the left column. The right page carries marginal notes (procul, purpura, quoties, potus, fluvius, qualis, quando, aliquando, etc.) that are largely illegible.
